**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



Zimmer Biomet is excited to announce that our **Summer Internship Program is back for 2026/27**.


This is a unique opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in the medical technology field, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop skills that directly impact patient care and customer experience.

  

 **Location:** Belrose, NSW


**Tentative Program Dates:** 30 November 2026 – 5 March 2027 (12 working weeks)


**Remuneration:** Paid internship

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------



You will primarily contribute to an AI\-based project to support process improvements around reporting, document control, data management and regulatory support activities across the Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (RA/QA) function, adding value to the internal RA/QA team and the broader business.


As part of the project, you will:

* Develop an understanding of RA/QA processes.
* Gain exposure to, and practical experience in, supporting compliance\-related activities within the medical device industry.
**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------



To be successful as a Zimmer Biomet Intern, you will bring:

* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in a team.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* A natural problem\-solving approach and curiosity to dig deep into challenges.
* Self\-drive and accountability to meet project deadlines.
* Familiarity with AI tools and data analytics tools, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, and Excel is highly desirable, as well as exposure to the medical device or healthcare industry.
**Your Background**
-------------------



This internship is designed with university students and early\-career applicants in mind. It is a chance to put your knowledge into practice, learn how a global medical device company operates and contribute to work that makes a genuine difference to patient outcomes. You will be given a project of your own, with clear objectives and a manager to guide you through it.

  

We welcome applications from students who have **recently completed, or are entering the final year of**, a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, science, business, data analytics, or a related field.

 **Important Information**

* Applicants **must be eligible to live and work in Australia**.
* Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* Application deadline – **Friday, 25th September 2026**

**To apply,** submit your CV and a short cover letter (one page maximum) telling us what interests you about regulatory and quality work in the medical device industry.

**OUR STORY**  

At FUJIFILM Business Innovation Australia, we help organisations make practical progress through technology. For more than 65 years, we’ve supported Australian businesses to manage information, work more securely, and grow confidently. Today, we continue to evolve, helping customers build the foundations for safe, responsible and effective digital transformation. When you join our team, you’ll grow your career while contributing to meaningful outcomes for our customers and business.


**THE OPPORTUNITY**  

We have an exciting 12 months part\-time opportunity (3 days/week) for an **IT Intern** to join our Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Division based in Macquarie Park, Sydney.


This hands\-on role offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced ICT professionals while gaining real\-world exposure to enterprise technology solutions. You will contribute to meaningful projects involving Power BI, Power Automate, AI technologies, and software development across a variety of languages and platforms (such as Java and .NET), helping to streamline business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support data\-driven decision\-making across the organisation.


As part of our collaborative and supportive team, you will receive on\-the\-job training, mentoring, and guidance from experienced technology professionals, providing an excellent foundation for building your career in IT.


Whether you're passionate about automation, data analytics, software development, or emerging AI technologies, this is a fantastic opportunity to develop practical skills, gain valuable industry experience, and make a real impact from day one!


**Why Join Us?**  

* Work with modern technologies and languages as projects require, including Power BI, Power Automate, Java, .NET, and AI tools
* Gain hands\-on experience in a real\-world enterprise IT environment
* Learn from experienced ICT professionals and business leaders
* Contribute to projects that drive innovation and business improvement
* Build valuable skills and experience to support your future career in technology
**Skills \& Qualifications**  

* Recent graduates or enrolled in Masters in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline
* A passion for technology and a desire to build a career in data, automation, software development, or AI
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and identify opportunities for improvement
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with a willingness to learn from others
* An interest in data visualisation, business intelligence, process automation, and emerging technologies
* Experience gained through academic projects, internships, part\-time roles, or personal projects will be highly regarded
**BENEFITS:**  

* In\-house training and development, supported by a generous Educational Assistance policy
* Diverse career development opportunities across the business
* Discounted access to a large network of gyms, pools and leisure centres through Fitness Passport
* Employee discounts, rewards and recognition through our Gold Pass platform
* Income protection and life insurance
* Salary packaging and novated leasing options
* Employee Resource Groups, including Community Champions, Pride, First Nations, Sustainability and Elevate (Women in Leadership network)
**OUR COMMITMENT**

At FUJIFILM BI Australia, our commitment is to create a workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to contribute. Through Fujifilm’s global Diverse Stories approach, we recognise that every person brings experiences, perspectives and aspirations that strengthen how we work together, support our customers and contribute to innovation.


We value diversity, equity and inclusion, and are committed to fair, respectful and inclusive workplace practices. By listening to different stories and learning from one another, we help bring the Fujifilm Group Purpose, “Giving Our World More Smiles”, to life. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Tarzan Digital is a strategy and growth partner for the built world. We work with construction and infrastructure businesses across Australia, helping them show their work the way it deserves to be seen. We're a small team that holds a high bar on everything we put out. Video and media is how we tell the story, it isn't the whole of what we are.

This is a paid three\-month internship built around mentoring. You'll work alongside our team and learn the craft across the whole agency, not just one corner of it: branding, strategy, social media management, filmmaking, photography, script writing and ad writing. It's a hands\-on seat for someone at the start of their career who wants to build real skills and a real body of work, not watch from the sidelines.

What you'll learn and be part of:

* Branding and strategy: how we position construction and infrastructure brands and plan content that actually means something
* Social media management: planning, publishing and managing content across LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook
* Filmmaking and photography: capturing projects, people and progress on real sites, to a premium standard
* Script and ad writing: shaping stories and writing copy that lands

What you'll be doing day to day:

* Out on site across NSW capturing footage and photos of live construction and infrastructure projects
* Editing and assembling content to our standard
* Managing media: transferring and backing up footage, creating and linking proxies, keeping the library clean and findable
* Supporting the team across shoots, edits and campaigns as we deliver for clients

Who we're after:

* Attitude over experience. If you're willing, coachable and easy to have on a job, we'll teach you the rest
* You love the creative game and you want to build a career, this one's for someone hungry to learn
* You've got an eye and a genuine work ethic
* You're comfortable on a worksite: reliable, professional, and happy to get amongst it around trades and site teams
* You're organised, the kind of person who names their files properly
* You hold a current driver's licence, you'll be travelling to client sites across NSW
* Looked on favourably but not essential: experience with Premiere Pro

We're a small team and culture is a big deal to us. You'll be working closely with us day in, day out, on site and back at the studio, so how you show up matters as much as what you can already do. We back each other, we hold a high standard, and we want someone who wants to be part of that, not just clock a shift.

 **We're****looking for students who:**

* Are currently enrolled at Macquarie University with ideally at least two years of study remaining.
* Demonstrate strong organisational and time management skills.
* Are confident communicators who can connect with a wide range of audiences.
* Enjoy helping others and providing accurate, helpful information.
* Act with professionalism, integrity and accountability when representing Macquarie University.
* Can work independently and contribute positively within a team environment.
* Are available to work across weekdays, evenings and weekends as required, including major university events.
* Hold a current Australian driver's licence (P1, P2 or Full) and are comfortable travelling to events across metropolitan and regional locations.
 **Highly regarded**


While not essential, we would love to hear about your experience in any of the following areas:

* Customer service, hospitality, retail, tutoring, mentoring or other people\-focused roles.
* Presenting, facilitating or public speaking.
* Developing content for social media or digital platforms.
* Leadership, volunteering or community involvement.
* Participation in university life through student groups, sport, PACE, exchange, mentoring programs, volunteering, leadership initiatives or other extracurricular activities.
* Experience using Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
 **Step 3: Show us your story**


Student Ambassadors are storytellers, communicators and connectors.


Submit a video (no longer than 2 minutes) introducing yourself and speaking about the following topics:

* Why did you choose Macquarie University?
* What do you enjoy most about your degree?
* What has been your most memorable experience at Macquarie?
